paragraphs.notes: Continuation of Tabelle 1 (Bandenmaxima der Raman-Spektren in [cm-1]) from page 3, printed under a bare (fortgesetzt) caption with no [00NN] marker of its own. The nearest preceding numbered paragraph is [0018] on page 3, which introduces Tabelle 1; this block is attached there. Only the three rows printed on page 4 are recorded here. The columns for Kristallmodifikation I and II are empty on this page: their lists ended on page 3 (I ends 883 / 3075, II ends 927 / 3096). Only Kristallmodifikation III continues, its left sub-column carrying on from 768 with 805, 832, 850 and its right sub-column carrying on from 2973 with 3020, 3073, 3099. Both sub-columns are ascending across the page break, which is the check that confirms the association. Tabelle 1 ends on this page.

Tabelle 2 starts and ends on this page: 23 printed rows, no (fortgesetzt) before or after it. It carries a bare Tabelle caption with no [00NN] marker; the nearest preceding numbered paragraph is [0018] on page 3, which states that the infrared band maxima are given in Tabelle 2, so this block is attached there. Read off the page image, not the text layer: the layout is six ruled columns grouped in pairs under three headings, and the text layer flattens them row-major so that the first printed row comes out as the flat run 593, 1164, 555, 1033, 555, 1154, which is one value from each of the six columns and not one series. Kristallmodifikation I holds 37 values (19 left, 18 right), II holds 45 (23 left, 22 right), III holds 46 (23 left, 23 right). Blank cells in the markdown are blank on the page, where a shorter list has run out while the others continue.

Tabelle 3 starts on this page with 14 printed rows and continues onto page 5 under a (fortgesetzt) caption; only the rows printed on page 4 are recorded here. Bare Tabelle caption with no [00NN] marker, attached to the nearest preceding numbered paragraph, which is [0018] on page 3. Four ruled columns, Bindung / Å(°) twice, read as two side-by-side column pairs continuing one list. The right pair mixes bond lengths with bond angles: from O(3)-C(9)-C(10) 107.7(2) onward the entries name three atoms and the value is an angle in degrees, which is why the column heading is Å(°). Decimal separators are printed as points, not German commas, and are recorded as printed.

notes: Column structure read off the page image before any number was transcribed, as the briefing requires. What I saw: the two spectral tables are ruled into six columns, not three. Three heading cells span the table width, Kristallmodifikation I, II and III, and each heading spans two unheaded numeric sub-columns below it, so the grouping is 2 + 2 + 2 under three headings. Within one modification the two sub-columns are one ascending list, the left column read top to bottom and continued at the top of the right column: in Tabelle 2 modification I runs 593 to 1138 down the left sub-column then 1164 to 3075 down the right, unbroken and ascending. The heavier vertical rules fall between modifications and there is no rule between a pair of sub-columns, which is the visual confirmation of the grouping. The extracted text layer walks these six columns row-major, so its flat run interleaves all three modifications and destroys the association; the text layer was used only to confirm digits I had already placed from the image, and every value matched. Tabelle 3 is ruled into four columns, Bindung / Å(°) repeated, and reads as two side-by-side pairs continuing one list rather than as two independent tables. The page has no running prose, no [00NN] paragraph marker and no chemical structure, so drawings is empty as a finding and not an omission. The numerals 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35, 40, 45, 50, 55 down the left margin are the EP line-number ruler, a publication artifact, and are not content. No hyphenated line breaks needed repair on this page. Vision pass performed by Claude Opus 5 (claude-opus-5[1m]).
blank_line_note: Blank lines inside paragraph zh/en were removed by the run owner. They came from the markdown-table convention this run uses to carry table content in the paragraph. build_enriched.py emits them into the enriched document, but english_by_line() in resolve_translations.py builds its `body` with `if t.strip()`, dropping blanks, while splitting the paragraph without dropping them. Any interior blank line therefore desynchronised the walk and it aborted, by design rather than guessing, which blocked verify.py for the whole run. Only whitespace-only lines were removed; every character of content is unchanged, asserted at the time of the edit.
